growth_signal.value: Round roughly three times the previous one within 19 months; expanding from Europe to the Americas and Asia-Pacific

raised.value: $13M in September 2026 led by Expedition Growth Capital, after a €4M Series A in February 2025

entry.idea: A data service where fund managers, banks and advisers search, compare and analyse every European exchange-traded fund in one place.
entry.lesson: A focused data product in a fast-growing asset class can take a slice from the incumbents without matching their whole catalogue.
entry.name: ETFbook

growth.basis: substitute: funding round bigger than the last
growth.reason: No revenue or client growth numbers published this year.

market.reason: Financial data is a huge market, but ETF analytics for institutions is a niche with a few thousand possible buyers.

tech.reason: Solid data engineering and coverage, which a well-funded rival could rebuild in months.

sources.title: ETFBOOK raises $13M to expand ETF data and analytics globally (Tech.eu)

entry.twist: It chose the ETF corner of the giant financial-data market, where the old giants are expensive and slow, and sells the same data by dashboard or by API.
entry.who_pays: Institutional clients such as fund issuers, banks and asset managers pay subscriptions; over 35 at the last count.
entry.why_now: ETFs are the fastest-growing way people invest, and the number of funds has outgrown the tools built for stocks and mutual funds.

mentions.snippet: ETF data and analytics platform expanding to the Americas and Asia; $13M raised.

Zurich; founded 2020 by Pawel Janus and Bartłomiej Igła; B2B data and analytics platform for European ETFs with dashboards and APIs; 30+ people across 10+ countries; 35+ institutional clients at Series A
